title: Reservation runway — customer GPU sprint (allocation grid & forecast)
body:
Purpose:
Quick-turn allocation sheet used by infra + sales to map committed GPU reservations to physical pools and forecast runway across regions for upcoming customer onboardings. This is a working sheet — contains soft vs hard allocations, reclaim windows, and sprint action items.

Key assumptions (do not change without sync):
- All reserved GPUs are expressed as vGPU-equivalent slots where 1 slot = 1 A100-40GB baseline. H100 counts as 2.0x, L4 as 0.4x.
- Cross-region burst capacity allowed up to 20% of pool but requires 48-hour notice and fallback to hosted API.
- Buffer pool = 5% of total Dedicated fleet per region; used for short-term spikes and onboarding ramp.
- Onboarding ramp = estimated ramp months to full utilization per contract.

Allocation grid (current snapshot):
Columns: Contract ID | Customer | Region(s) | GPU type | Reserved slots | Active allocation | Utilization % (30d avg) | Onboard ramp (months) | Months committed remaining | Notes
C-1007 | Zephyr Health | us-west1 | A100-40GB | 48 | 42 | 88% | 1 | 10 | Hard reservation, allow cross-region burst to us-east1 up to 10 slots during evaluation window. Needs KMS onboarding week of 2026-03-01.
C-1012 | AtlasSearch | eu-central1, us-east1 | H100-80GB | 64 (H100 -> count 128 eq) | 38 | 45% | 3 | 24 | Soft allocation across two regions; recommended pin to eu-central1 for latency. Sales negotiating 50% commit ramp.
C-1029 | Mallory Labs | us-east1 | L4-24GB | 200 (L4 -> count 80 eq) | 50 | 62% | 4 | 6 | Small-but-many-worker pattern. Put 12 slots in buffer pool for onboarding bursts.
C-1035 | Nimbus AI | ap-southeast1 | H100-80GB | 16 | 16 | 95% | 0.5 | 12 | High-util customer on support SLA; consider prewarming KV cache. No cross-region allowed (compliance).
C-1040 | RetailCo | us-west1 | A100-40GB | 120 | 60 | 55% | 2 | 36 | Seasonal spikes expected in Q4; plan for 40-slot burst window Nov-Dec.
C-1048 | GovState | us-east1 (private) | A100-40GB | 40 | 10 | 25% | 6 | 60 | Private deployment (air-gapped) — capacity accounted separately from public pool. Recovery window longer (72 hrs).

Aggregate view (region pools):
us-west1: total fleet eq slots 1,200 | committed reserved  (hard+soft) 640 | buffer pool 60 (5%) | uncovered demand forecast next 6 months: +120 eq slots (onboardings + growth)
us-east1: total fleet eq slots 900 | committed reserved 420 | buffer pool 45 | uncovered forecast: +95 eq slots
eu-central1: total fleet eq slots 600 | committed reserved 160 | buffer pool 30 | uncovered forecast: +30 eq slots
ap-southeast1: total fleet eq slots 300 | committed reserved 48 | buffer pool 15 | uncovered forecast: +20 eq slots

Forecast runway notes:
- With current onboarding estimates, public pools will exhaust usable buffer in us-west1 in ~2.5 months unless we: (a) shift AtlasSearch to eu-central1 early, (b) accelerate hardware procurement, or (c) offer time-shifted start to RetailCo.
- Opportunity: reclaim 40 eq slots from dormant internal test projects (ticket ENG-1499).

Open action items (owner / due):
- Jordan Kim: Confirm AtlasSearch final region by 2026-02-25 (affects eu vs us allocation). (ENG-1427)
- Maya Patel: Submit procurement request for +180 A100-equivalent slots for US regions (req-2026-Q3) by 2026-03-05.
- Sofia Alvarez: Draft customer communication for RetailCo Q4 burst policy by 2026-03-01.
- Ethan Zhao: Run nightly slot-utilation report and flag buckets <30% utilization for potential reassign. (PR:github.com/redwood/inference/allocate-runway)

Risks / mitigation:
- Overcommit risk: multiple soft allocations with overlapping burst windows. Mitigate by hard pinning at least 60% of committed reservation for first 90 days post-contract.
- Compliance constraint: GovState private pool cannot be used for burst — adjust public buffer calculations accordingly.
- Hardware lead time: H100 procurement 12–16 weeks; plan gating clauses into onboarding SOWs.

Notes to reviewers (working):
- This is intentionally conservative in the cross-region burst numbers. If Sales signs multi-quarter guarantee we can move allocations from soft -> hard with 7-day notice.
- See linked Confluence page for past-quarter utilization trends and historical reclaim success rates.

Change log (brief):
- 2025-11-02: initial draft (Maya)
- 2025-12-18: added RetailCo seasonal burst plan (Sofia)
- 2026-01-10: updated H100 equivalence factors & region pool counts (Jordan)
- 2026-02-18: updated AtlasSearch soft allocation and added sprint action items (Maya)

Unresolved questions:
- Should we treat L4 reservations as first-class or convert to A100-equivalent for all reporting? (Impacts capacity percent and buffer calc)
- Can SRE accept 48-hour cross-region warming policy as standard? If not, mark cross-region bursts as manual approvals.
- Do we grant customers X-slot "prewarm" credit that is billed but held in buffer? Policy unfinalized.

Quick checklist for next coordination meeting:
- [ ] Lock AtlasSearch regional pin
- [ ] Publish procurement request
- [ ] Author customer-facing burst policy doc
- [ ] Run candidate reclaim list and present top 3 pools for reassign

Last sync notes (from standup 2026-02-16):
- AtlasSearch leaning eu-central1; Sales to confirm by end of week.
- Procurement path approved for Q3 units; finance awaiting final quantity.
- SRE wants automated reclaim flagging before manual reassigns.

Contact and context: Maya Patel (owner) — slack @maya.patel; sheet used as single source-of-truth for sprint capacity discussions.
